tweets.text: Congrats to @lightseekorg on the impressive TokenSpeed results! 🚀 Great to see Qwen3.8-Flash-Next reaching 685 output tokens/s per user on Nvida GPUs. Excited to see the community unlock more of Qwen’s inference potential! https://t.co/yudaS4VgBW

It launches with two core designs: 🥳
- Elastic Scheduler: reallocates GPUs between rollout & training as demand shifts—live executions never interrupted. Up to 1.85× speedup over https://t.co/wMDoJOuP2j

Built on Qwen-Image-2.1, Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint on the same 7B visual generation architecture.

Five models, one complete audio stack: understanding, generation, interaction & creation.

Thanks @arena for the recognition! 🏆 Qwen-Image-2.1 is now the #1 open-source model in both the Image Edit and Text-to-Image Arenas. Try it now and show us what you create! 🎨 https://t.co/hQY2kRxg5D
Day-0 OpenVINO support from @inteldevs! 🥳 Qwen-Image-2.1 is ready to run optimized on Intel hardware. One open-weight checkpoint for both generation and editing. 👇 https://t.co/GULXxCQgzt

Thanks @sgl_project for the day-0 support! 🙌 SGLang-Diffusion now serves Qwen-Image-2.1: text-to-image generation, multi-image editing, and transparent RGBA output. Try it out! 🎨 https://t.co/32IjeuFl4b
Qwen-Image-2.1 × @HuggingApps: live demo on Spaces! 🖼 One single checkpoint for generation and editing. Try it in your browser, no setup needed. 👇 https://t.co/wxSiIzyJfK
Qwen-Image-2.1 is now supported in ComfyUI! Try it now and share your creations! 🖼️ https://t.co/VHjOl0oLJu
Thanks @vllm_project for the day-0 support! 🙌 Generate, edit, transparent output — one model, ready to serve. Details 👇 https://t.co/L7kT6dbS20
Qwen-Image-2.1 also improves visual quality over its predecessor, particularly in the aesthetics of text and portraits. Below are several examples of text rendering. https://t.co/wzoZmyBWv9

Qwen-Image-2.1 supports a variety of editing tasks while balancing performance across them. For example, given a three-view character reference, the model generates a complete storyboard. https://t.co/CKELeRLyhH

Qwen-Image-2.1 supports several ways to specify local edits. The example below uses circles to identify three regions and asks the model to “remove the metal watch in the blue circle, change the hair in the red circle to black, and replace the area in the green circle with gray https://t.co/K7oQ7aBS8p
Qwen-Image-2.1 supports up to 10 reference images and can produce high-quality results. https://t.co/TuTvzEGhy8
Qwen-Image-2.1 now supports transparent image generation natively, and naturally supports editing transparent images as well. https://t.co/U7kpwnrGHE
